final: WITH c AS (SELECT ma.department AS d, COUNT(DISTINCT i.link_to_member) AS cnt FROM income i JOIN member m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY ma.department), s AS (SELECT d, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, (SELECT avg_share FROM a) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - (SELECT avg_share FROM a)) AS avg_diff FROM s WHERE s.share > (SELECT avg_share FROM a)
